family.description: This entry represents a domain that covers the whole protein sequence in EpsI from Methylobacillus sp. 12S. EpsI is encoded immediately downstream of the multiple-membrane-spanning putative transporter EpsH, and is predicted to be a periplasmic protein involved in, but not required for, expression of the exopolysaccharide methanolan. In a number of other species, protein homologues to EpsI are encoded either next to epsH or, more often, combined in a fused gene [[cite:PUB00021014]]. This domain is found associated with [pfam:PF09721].
family.name: Methanolan biosynthesis EpsI
